I went to school for a few years, so I can read the name on the fertilizer bag, but I still follow what my mother taught me and what I see working in my neighbor's field. This land is borrowed, so I will not waste my manure here, but I will buy one bag of NPK 20-10-10 because the agro-dealer said it helps and my neighbor used it last season with a better harvest. I do not have money for improved seed or spraying chemicals this year, so I will plant the seed I kept from last season and hope the rains come well. My children and I will work this plot for about sixty days, and I will hire two young men for three days to help with the clearing because that work is too hard for me alone.
